description: In-game Wave Info panel readings from one Tier 12 campaign run, waves 1 to 180, one reading per wave. Every value is what the panel displayed; nothing is derived.

provenance.source: Screenshots of the game's Wave Info panel, read by tooling/panel-capture/tower-panel-capture.swift (text recognition, each reading validated by format, chance total and repeated cells)
provenance.runs: One capture run of one battle, started at wave 1. All 180 waves read completely. The battle ended at wave 180, killed by a Boss, per the game export.

account.note: Same account as the Tier 1 and Tier 7 fixtures.

perks.note: Auto Pick Perks was off for this battle. No trade-off perk shows in the panel: Boss health is 20 times Basic, Boss speed equals the Protector's and Ranged attack equals Basic attack at every reading.

notes: Health and attack are the panel's text: a mantissa cut (not rounded) to two decimals, and a suffix from 1,000 up.
attackSkips and healthSkips are the panel's Enemy Attack / Health Level Skip counters. The enemy level for a stat is the wave less that counter.
eliteEach is the chance shown on each of the Vampire, Scatter and Ray rows.
The speed of Fast, Tank, Ranged, Protector and Boss is recorded beside Basic so the per-type ratios can be checked.

mass.note: Identical in every reading, and identical to Tier 1 and Tier 7.
